Shifted tripling implies d>=4/3; at equality the limit is K min(x,y)^(1/3)(max(x,y)+min(x,y)/2), without an assumed diagonal derivative.

claims.limitations: Completion of an earlier local draft using attributed external constructions. No tensor character at equality is constructed or excluded; no independent review or exponent improvement.

claims.title: Central involution quotient bound for group-potential constructions
claims.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
claims.statement: In a three-set group-potential degeneration with injective cyclic pair maps, a central-involution pair in S forces T times U to inject into the central quotient. Hence |T||U|<=|G|/2. Shape (16,16,17) in SL(2,7) forbids all central pairs.

claims.limitations: Only the stated coordinate-potential witness class. Not an obstruction to arbitrary complex degenerations or an exponent improvement.
